name: managedDevices
description: Devices enrolled in Intune with their compliance state, platform and primary user

getArgs.value: {{ [[].concat(complianceStates || []).map((v) => (v && v.value) || v).filter(Boolean).map((v) => `complianceState eq '${String(v).split(`'`).join(`''`)}'`).join(' or '), [].concat(operatingSystems || []).map((v) => (v && v.value) || v).filter(Boolean).map((v) => `operatingSystem eq '${String(v).split(`'`).join(`''`)}'`).join(' or ')].filter(Boolean).map((c) => `(${c})`).join(' and ') || null }}

metadata.name: osBuild
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const v = $['osVersion']; const s = typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'number' ? String(v).trim() : ''; return s ? s.split('.').slice(0, 3).join('.') : null; })() }}

metadata.name: osPatchLevel
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const v = $['osVersion']; const s = typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'number' ? String(v).trim() : ''; const p = s.split('.'); return p.length === 4 && p.every((x) => /^[0-9]+$/.test(x)) ? s : null; })() }}
